appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, common room and then called away to kitchen
appearances.notable_actions: Takes Rand and Mat to a corner table; has serving maid bring food; explains the food shortage situation; offers to help them find Moiraine if she comes to Caemlyn; warns them against going to Elaida or the Guards because of Thom connection; assigns them an attic room; gets called away by the cook
appearances.demeanor: helpful, cautious, practical, somewhat harried by the cook

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; common room, then attic room, then back downstairs to library
appearances.notable_actions: Tells Master Gill a simplified version of their troubles; tries to encourage Mat to eat and not give up; explores the inn when Mat withdraws; discovers the library; initially mistakes Loial for a Trolloc and yells; talks extensively with Loial about their respective journeys; tells Loial the truth about Trollocs, Fades, and their pursuit; learns about ta'veren from Loial; declines Loial's offer to travel with them; agrees to talk and play stones with Loial while in Caemlyn
appearances.demeanor: worried, scared, determined not to give up, homesick, relieved to finally talk openly with someone, cautious about endangering others

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; common room briefly, then attic room
appearances.notable_actions: Frowns at his food; mutters bitterly about their situation and declares their friends dead; throws himself on bed in cloak and boots; clutches the dagger; refuses to come back downstairs
appearances.demeanor: bitter, withdrawn, paranoid, despairing, suspicious of everyone including Master Gill

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn library in Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Reading when Rand enters; explains he's an Ogier, not a Trolloc; describes his first four days in Caemlyn and the mob that chased him; tells Rand about leaving his stedding without permission; explains Ogier history and their work with groves and stone; teaches Rand about the Pattern and ta'veren; identifies Rand as ta'veren; asks to travel with Rand; accepts Rand's refusal gracefully; asks to talk and play stones while they're both in Caemlyn
appearances.demeanor: patient, friendly, scholarly, eager to share knowledge, sympathetic to Rand's losses, hopeful about traveling
